fields.title: 📖 The gravest punishment is a hard heart
fields.body:
🖋️ **Mālik ibn Dīnār** رحمه الله said:

***“Among the punishments of the Exalted Allāh upon hearts and bodies are:***

***constraint in provision and weakness in worship.***

***And no servant was struck with a greater punishment than hardness of the heart.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Not every punishment is immediately visible. Among the most dangerous punishments is a hard heart that remains untouched by admonition, makes light of sin, and no longer feels humility in worship.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym al-Iṣbahānī, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ wa-Ṭabaqāt al-Aṣfiyāʾ, Bd. 6, S. 287
